title: Part-Time Claude Code Developer for AI Dashboards and Workflows (NYC Law Firm, Remote)
description:
➡️ About Us

We are a virtual assistant agency that places skilled remote professionals with established businesses. Our client is a well-known law firm in New York City. They are already building software with Claude Code and need a hands-on developer to help them move faster.

➡️ About the Role

You will work directly with one of the firm’s partners, who builds with Claude Code himself. You will meet with him to plan each piece of work, then go build it. This is not a one-off project. If it’s a good fit, the role continues long-term.

➡️ What You Will Do

-Maintain and update the firm’s marketing software, which is built on Claude and already well along
-Build out a dashboard that collects firm data and integrates with Airtable and other software
-Set up Claude Projects, prompts, and AI workflows the firm’s team can use day to day
-Join planning sessions with the partner, then turn those plans into working builds
-Fix bugs and ship updates as needs come up

➡️ What You Need

-Hands-on experience building with Claude Code
-Solid experience with Claude Projects and prompt writing
-Experience connecting tools through APIs, especially Airtable
-Experience building dashboards or internal tools
-Clear written and spoken English
-Able to take direction, ask good questions, and work independently after a plan is set
-Some availability during Eastern Time business hours for planning calls
-Discretion with confidential information

➡️ Nice to Have

-Experience working with a law firm or other professional services firm
-Experience with other AI tools beyond Claude
-Experience with automation tools like Zapier, Make, or n8n

➡️ Schedule

-Part-time, remote
-Long-term if it works out

➡️ How to Apply

Please follow these steps. Applications that skip them will not be reviewed.

-Start your cover letter with the word “Aloha” so we know you read the full post
-Tell us about a dashboard, internal tool, or AI workflow you built with Claude Code
-Record a 2 to 3 minute Loom video introducing yourself. Show or walk us through a similar project you built and explain your part in it
-Include your Loom link and any portfolio or GitHub links in your proposal

We look forward to meeting you.

title: AI Product Builder | Remote | Full-Time | Pakistan
description:
About the role:
We're looking for a proactive AI Product Builder with strong product judgment, a good eye for UX design, and the ability to turn ideas into functional products using AI tools.

You'll initially focus on building our AI-powered Marketing Engine and other tools that help automate workflows, improve efficiency, and support business growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys understanding user needs, designing intuitive solutions, and taking ownership of products from idea to launch.

Key Responsibilities:
- Own product development from idea to launch, including research, planning, prototyping, testing, and improvement.
- Work with marketing and other teams to understand user needs and identify opportunities.
- Design intuitive, user-friendly products and workflows.
- Use AI tools, AI agents, and development platforms to build functional products and automate processes.
- Build and improve AI-powered marketing tools for content creation, campaigns, outreach, and analytics.
- Research emerging AI technologies and explore practical business applications.
- Gather feedback, improve product usability, and measure results.
- Independently drive projects forward, solve problems, and communicate progress.

Requirements:
- 3+ years building or shipping digital products as a product manager, product designer, product developer, or related roles.
- Strong product judgment and understanding of user needs.
- Good eye for UI/UX design and attention to detail.
- Hands-on experience using AI tools to build products, prototypes, or automation workflows.
- Ability to turn ideas into practical, working solutions.
- Strong initiative, ownership, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, remote environment.

Nice to Have:
- Software development or programming experience, particularly with web applications, APIs, or integrations.
- Experience with AI coding assistants, AI agents, or no-code/low-code platforms.
- Experience building marketing tools or automation solutions.
- Experience launching products independently or in a startup environment.

What we value:
You should enjoy understanding user needs, exploring new technologies, and turning ideas into practical solutions. We value someone who takes ownership, pays attention to user experience, and independently figures things out rather than waiting for instructions.

We value someone who naturally thinks:
- What problem are we trying to solve, and who are we solving it for?
- How can we make this product simpler, more intuitive, and useful?
- How can I use AI and other tools to bring this idea to life?
- What can I learn from user feedback to improve the product?
- What opportunities can I proactively identify and build solutions for?

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who takes initiative, learns quickly, and enjoys turning ideas into products that make a real impact.

Benefits & Perks:
- Fully Remote Work – Work remotely with a reliable internet connection
- Healthcare Coverage – We provide health benefits for you and your family’s well-being
- Leave Days, Vacation Time, and Paid Holidays – Recharge and take the time you need
- Equipment Funds – Get support to set up or upgrade your home office
- Profit Sharing – Monthly and annual bonuses tied to company performance
- Long-Term Employment – We value team members who grow with us
- Collaborative Team Culture – Work with a supportive and globally distributed team

About Us:
AutoScale Ventures is a technology-driven company with 50+ team members across the Philippines, Pakistan, India, the U.S., China, and Canada. We operate a group of businesses spanning tech, data services, infrastructure, and AI. Some of our main products and ventures include:
- Vehicle data (VinAudit.com)
- Proxy Infrastructure solutions (SquidProxies.com)

title: Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Architect (Contract, US-Based)
description:
We're looking for a US-based Dynamics 365 F&O architect to join us as an independent contractor, reporting directly to the Director of Systems and Operations.

The core job is to assess our current Dynamics 365 environment, understand how it's structured today, identify gaps, and provide a clear roadmap of recommendations. You should be someone who can look at a Dynamics implementation and quickly tell us what's working, what's not, and what needs to change.

What we're looking for: deep experience with Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations, including environment architecture, configuration, reporting (Power BI), and integrations. You should be comfortable working independently with minimal hand-holding and be able to communicate findings clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

Strong preference for candidates who are AI-native, meaning you actively use AI tools in your day to day work to move faster, analyze data, generate documentation, and solve problems. If you think with AI alongside your D365 expertise, that's a major plus.

Engagement type: Independent contractor, remote, US-based only. Flexible hours with availability during EST business hours.

If this sounds like you, send a brief note on your D365 experience and how you use AI in your work. We move fast.

title: CRM & API Integration Expert (Salesmate / GoHighLevel) – Long-Term Technical Partner
description:
We are an established legal marketing and intake company seeking an experienced CRM, API Integration, and Marketing Automation Specialist for ongoing project-based work.

We currently use Salesmate CRM and are looking for someone with strong experience in both Salesmate and GoHighLevel who can become our trusted, go-to technical expert.

**Our immediate needs include:**

- Configuring APIs, webhooks, and integrations with third-party lead generation companies and media vendors.
- Ensuring incoming leads are automatically routed into the correct CRM campaigns, pipelines, and assigned representatives.
- Setting up and activating existing customer journeys, automated SMS/email drip campaigns, follow-up sequences, and trigger-based workflows whenever new campaigns or lead sources are added.
- Troubleshooting CRM integrations, lead delivery issues, and automation failures.
- Communicating directly with outside vendors and their technical teams.

**An especially important part of this role is vendor communication.** We need someone we can introduce into group chats and email threads as our company's technical point of contact. When a lead vendor asks for API specifications, webhook URLs, field mapping, or integration requirements, we want you to take ownership of the technical conversation and handle the setup from beginning to end.

**Future projects include a complete migration from Salesmate to GoHighLevel**, including multiple sub-accounts, existing contacts, pipelines, automations, phone systems, and vendor integrations.

We prefer fixed-price arrangements for individual projects, beginning with smaller assignments and progressing to more substantial work.

We are not looking for a general IT support person or basic CRM administrator. We need someone with proven hands-on experience who understands CRM infrastructure, API integrations, customer journeys, and marketing automation.

Excellent English communication, reliability, and the ability to work independently are essential. Availability during U.S. Pacific business hours for vendor coordination is preferred.

**Our goal is to establish a long-term working relationship with someone who can effectively become our outsourced technical lead as our company continues to grow.**

title: Build Internal Client Onboarding Platform — Google Cloud, Next.js, Claude API
description:
I run a CPA firm and we onboard roughly five new clients a week. Right now that process is held together by a Calendly booking, an optional intake form, an Excel tracker, a Dropbox folder, and a lot of manual email. My team spends more time moving information between those systems than they do on actual client work, and things fall through the cracks — mostly prospects who book a meeting without filling out the intake form, and clients who stall mid-onboarding without anyone noticing.

I want to replace that with a single internal web app that my firm logs into with our Google Workspace accounts.

What it needs to do:

A Calendly webhook creates the client record. The app matches the optional intake form to that record by email and flags anyone who booked without submitting one. It generates a research brief and a draft pre-meeting email for my staff to review and edit — drafts get written into Gmail, and a person sends them. Nothing goes to a client automatically. After the meeting, one button creates the document folder and sends the tax organizer. As documents come in, the app checks them against the expected list and tells me what's missing. When I approve, it triggers the DocuSign engagement letter and updates the client's status. Discounts and scope changes need to be real states in the pipeline, not exceptions that drop off the board.

Stack I have in mind (open to being argued out of any of it):

Google Cloud — Cloud Run, Cloud SQL, Secret Manager, Document AI. Next.js front end behind Google Workspace SSO. Calendly and DocuSign APIs. Claude API for the drafting and research work.

Important: we handle tax documents, so this falls under the FTC Safeguards Rule and IRS Pub 4557. I need someone who takes that seriously — SSO and MFA through Workspace, encryption at rest and in transit, an append-only audit log of every automated action and human approval, and a short write-up of the architecture I can attach to our written information security plan.

Looking for: someone comfortable across backend, front end, and cloud infrastructure who can scope this into phases and ship the first one. Python or TypeScript both fine. Prior work with GCP and with LLM APIs in a production setting matters more to me than a specific framework.

Happy to discuss budget and timeline. I'd like to start with a paid discovery phase — map the current process, agree on the data model, and come back with a phased plan before writing much code.

title: Full-Stack Developer for Wedding Venue Portal Prototype
description:
I’m looking for a developer with both full-stack web development and AI integration experience to build a working prototype of a wedding venue planning portal.

The product gives booked couples one place to access venue documents, view important deadlines, ask a venue-specific AI assistant questions, and find their coordinator’s contact information.

This first project is a desktop sales demonstration using one fictional venue and couple. I will provide the visual mockup, branding, copy, images, documents, AI knowledge base and assistant instructions.

PROTOTYPE SCOPE

• A polished desktop portal based on the supplied mockup.
• Venue-branded header with a logo, image, couple’s names and wedding date.
• Horizontally scrollable cards showing important deadlines.
• Horizontally scrollable document/resource cards with working document links.
• Coordinator section displaying a photo and contact details.
• An embedded AI assistant that answers questions using the supplied venue knowledge and instructions.
• The AI assistant should remember earlier messages within the current demo conversation and respond appropriately to follow-up questions.
• A branded footer.
• Deployment to a working URL, testing and handover documentation.

The couple’s details, deadlines and resource cards can use fixed demo information. Automatic deadline calculations are not required for this phase. This will be a Phase 2 project. 

AI ASSISTANT REQUIREMENTS

The assistant must use the supplied venue knowledge, follow the supplied instructions and handle follow-up questions. When information is unavailable or a request requires venue approval, it should direct the couple to their coordinator.

The developer will implement the AI integration, knowledge retrieval and conversation handling. API credentials must remain server-side.

TECHNICAL DIRECTION

Preferred: React or Next.js, server-side OpenAI integration, and ChatKit or a suitable chat interface.

I’m open to recommendations for a simple, maintainable backend, storage and hosting setup.

Keep venue-specific branding, content, documents, instructions and deadline information separate from application components so additional venues can be configured later. A venue administration dashboard is not required for the prototype, this will be needed in further phases. 

The source code, repository, hosting and service accounts must be controlled by my business.

OUTSIDE THIS PROTOTYPE

Mobile responsiveness, real couple accounts, automatic deadline calculations, persistent history across devices, and venue administration tools are outside this project.

These will be within a separately scoped and paid second phase once a pilot venue is finalized.

BUDGET AND TIMELINE

The prototype development budget is $750 USD. Hosting, API usage and other ongoing service costs should be quoted separately. 

Target completion is by November 30 2026. Please confirm your earliest realistic delivery date.

If the requested scope exceeds the budget, identify what you can deliver within it and price any additions separately.

title: Part-Time Automation & Lead Gen Lead: n8n, APIs, Airtable, Outreach
description:
I’m a business owner looking for an experienced automation professional to own our workflows, client onboarding automation, and lead generation systems. I handle all sales.

My businesses serve behavioral health treatment centers and local service businesses. We’re growing, and I need someone who takes ownership, solves problems, and keeps projects moving without detailed instructions for every step.

Responsibilities

Build, maintain, and troubleshoot n8n automations connecting phone systems, email, CRMs, and Airtable.
Configure and test AI phone agents (Retell), call routing, transfers, SMS, and notifications.
Automate client onboarding, from intake through testing and launch.
Build targeted lead lists and run cold email and LinkedIn outreach systems, including domains, warmup, and deliverability.
Route leads and replies into Airtable and hand warm leads to me.
Keep a clear project tracker, flag blockers, and hit deadlines.
Document repeatable processes so each new client doesn’t start from scratch.

Skills and experience

Strong hands-on n8n experience (or a comparable tool).

title: SmartSheet Solution Architect
description:
Smartsheet Solution Architect / Project & Portfolio Management Specialist

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced Smartsheet Solution Architect / Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Specialist to design, administer, support, and continuously enhance our enterprise Smartsheet environment.
This is a hands-on role requiring strong experience designing and supporting scalable Smartsheet solutions for project intake, demand management, project provisioning, project execution, program management, portfolio reporting, and PMO governance.
The ideal candidate will have advanced experience with Smartsheet Control Center, blueprint and template architecture, automated project provisioning, Data Shuttle, Dynamic View, reports, dashboards, workflow automation, formulas, cross-sheet references, cell linking, permissions, and workspace design.
The individual will work closely with project managers, program and portfolio managers, PMO leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams. The role combines Smartsheet solution architecture, PPM solution support, platform administration, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
A successful candidate should understand not only how to configure Smartsheet, but also how a well-designed PPM environment operates across the project lifecycle:
 
Key Responsibilities
Smartsheet Solution Architecture & PPM Design
•	Design, maintain, and enhance scalable Smartsheet solutions supporting project, program, and portfolio management.
•	Translate business and PMO requirements into sustainable Smartsheet architecture and solutions.
•	Maintain standardized project and portfolio structures, including project metadata, project plans, reports, dashboards, RAID information, milestones, status reporting, and portfolio data.
•	Design solutions supporting the complete project lifecycle from intake and demand management through project provisioning, execution, reporting, and closure.
•	Ensure project-level information appropriately rolls up into program, portfolio, and executive-level reporting.
•	Establish and maintain solution standards for naming conventions, project structures, workspace organization, permissions, templates, metadata, and governance.
•	Evaluate existing solutions and identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, automate, and improve the Smartsheet environment.
•	Maintain solution scalability and reliability as new projects, programs, portfolios, and users are added.
•	Ensure changes to shared templates, blueprints, data structures, or reporting components are appropriately evaluated before implementation to minimize unintended impacts to existing projects.
 
Required Qualifications
1.	3–7 years of relevant experience in Smartsheet solution development, administration, PPM solutions, PMO technology, or a comparable area, including advanced hands-on Smartsheet experience in a business or enterprise environment.
2.	Strong hands-on experience with Smartsheet Control Center, including designing, configuring, and maintaining blueprints, standardized project templates, project metadata, and provisioning configurations.
3.	Demonstrated experience supporting the end-to-end project intake and provisioning lifecycle, including demand intake, approvals, project creation, and automated project provisioning.
4.	Strong understanding of project, program, and portfolio management structures, including PMO governance, standardized project structures, project lifecycle processes, and how project information rolls up through program and portfolio levels.
5.	Experience designing and maintaining Smartsheet sheets, forms, reports, dashboards, and automated workflows supporting project, program, and portfolio management.
6.	Strong knowledge of Smartsheet formulas, cross-sheet references, cell links, and project metadata, including their use in project and portfolio reporting and data rollups.
7.	Experience designing and supporting project, program, and portfolio reporting solutions, including dashboards and aggregated reporting that provide visibility into project status, health, milestones, risks, and other key portfolio information.
8.	Experience designing and administering Smartsheet workspaces, permissions, users, groups, licenses, and access structures in an enterprise environment.
9.	Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills, with the ability to identify root causes and resolve configuration, provisioning, automation, reporting, access, and data issues.
10.	Ability to translate business and PMO requirements into scalable, standardized, and maintainable Smartsheet solutions, and to work effectively with project managers, program and portfolio managers, PMO leadership, business stakeholders, and technical teams.
11.	Strong written and verbal communication and documentation skills, including the ability to document solution designs, processes, requirements, configurations, and support procedures.
Additional Technical Knowledge
1.	A general understanding of Azure-hosted applications, APIs, databases, integrations, authentication, and application logs is beneficial but not required.
2.	
 
Highly Desirable Experience
Experience with one or more of the following would be highly desirable:
•	Smartsheet Dynamic View
•	Smartsheet Data Shuttle
•	DataMesh
•	Bridge
•	WorkApps
•	Resource Management
•	Jira integration / Jira Connector
•	Salesforce integration / Salesforce Connector
•	Power BI
•	Smartsheet API and system integrations
•	Supporting a global or enterprise PMO
•	Project portfolio management in a multi-client or multi-business-unit environment
•	Pharma, biotechnology, or life sciences experience
•	Relevant Smartsheet certifications or credentials
 
Preferred Candidate Profile
We are seeking someone who is more than a Smartsheet administrator or power user. The successful candidate should be capable of operating as a hands-on Smartsheet Solution Architect and PPM Specialist, while also taking responsibility for day-to-day platform administration, support, and continuous improvement.
The candidate should be comfortable owning and supporting a PPM architecture spanning:
Intake → Approval → Provisioning → Project Execution → Program Management → Portfolio Reporting → Executive Visibility → Closure
The individual should be able to work independently, diagnose issues across interconnected Smartsheet components, understand the operational needs of project and program managers, and improve existing solutions without introducing unnecessary complexity.
 
Location & Work Arrangement
Location, work authorization, time-zone requirements, remote-work expectations, and employment arrangement will be defined based on the position's hiring geography.
This role may be filled through a full-time, contract, or contract-to-hire arrangement, depending on business requirements and candidate availability.
 

 Detailed Responsibilities & Scope of Work
The following section provides additional detail regarding the hands-on responsibilities associated with the role.
2. Control Center, Intake & Project Provisioning
•	Configure, maintain, and support Smartsheet Control Center.
•	Design and maintain Control Center blueprints, project templates, intake processes, project metadata, and provisioning configurations.
•	Support project and demand intake, including approval workflows and the transition of approved requests into active projects.
•	Configure and support automated project provisioning using standardized project structures.
•	Ensure provisioning creates the required project assets, including project plans, metadata, reports, dashboards, workspace structures, and permissions.
•	Validate newly provisioned projects to ensure required assets, links, formulas, automation, and reporting components are operating correctly.
•	Troubleshoot provisioning failures and resolve configuration issues affecting newly created projects.
•	Maintain existing blueprints and templates as PMO and business requirements evolve.
•	Evaluate blueprint and template changes for potential impact on existing projects and portfolio reporting before deployment.
 
3. Project, Program & Portfolio Management
•	Support Smartsheet solutions used by project managers, program managers, portfolio managers, and PMO leadership.
•	Maintain project intake information, project plans, project metadata, portfolio data, and status reporting.
•	Support standardized tracking of: 
o	Schedules and milestones
o	Dependencies
o	Risks and issues
o	Project status and health
o	Ownership and accountability
o	Key project metrics
o	Project and portfolio reporting
•	Maintain consistent project structures and data standards across the environment.
•	Support portfolio-level visibility into project health, status, timelines, ownership, delivery performance, and key metrics.
•	Understand and maintain how individual project information contributes to program and enterprise portfolio reporting.
•	Assist project and program managers in resolving issues affecting project tracking or reporting.
 
4. Reports, Dashboards & Portfolio Reporting
•	Create, maintain, and enhance project-, program-, portfolio-, and executive-level reports.
•	Build and maintain Smartsheet dashboards for leadership, PMO teams, program and portfolio managers, project managers, and business stakeholders.
•	Configure reports using appropriate filters, grouping, sorting, and summary information.
•	Maintain dashboard widgets, metrics, reports, links, and supporting data sources.
•	Develop scalable reporting structures that aggregate information across multiple projects.
•	Troubleshoot reporting discrepancies and identify the underlying source of incorrect or missing information.
•	Ensure portfolio dashboards accurately reflect underlying project and program data.
 
5. Smartsheet Platform Administration & User Support
•	Serve as a primary administrator and support resource for the organization's Smartsheet environment.
•	Manage users, groups, permissions, roles, and license assignments.
•	Support user onboarding and offboarding.
•	Troubleshoot login, access, sharing, permissions, and licensing issues.
•	Monitor license utilization and support license optimization.
•	Maintain appropriate access to sheets, reports, dashboards, workspaces, and related Smartsheet assets.
•	Maintain workspace and permission architecture appropriate for project, program, portfolio, and business-user needs.
•	Provide day-to-day support to project managers, PMO users, and business stakeholders.
•	Troubleshoot functional, data, workflow, reporting, and configuration issues.
 
6. Formulas, Cross-Sheet References & Automation
•	Design, create, maintain, and troubleshoot Smartsheet formulas and calculations.
•	Develop and maintain cross-sheet formulas, references, and cell links supporting project, program, and portfolio reporting.
•	Troubleshoot broken, incorrect, or outdated references and cell links.
•	Develop and maintain automated workflows supporting: 
o	Notifications and alerts
o	Reminders
o	Approval processes
o	Update requests
o	Escalations
o	Status changes
o	Other PMO and business processes
•	Optimize formulas, references, and automation for reliability, scalability, performance, and maintainability.
•	Assess dependencies before modifying shared formulas, references, or automation.
 
7. Data Shuttle & Data Management
•	Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot Smartsheet Data Shuttle workflows.
•	Support automated data movement between Smartsheet and approved external data sources.
•	Maintain source-to-target mappings, update behaviors, and workflow configurations.
•	Troubleshoot workflow failures, mapping problems, data inconsistencies, and synchronization issues.
•	Monitor scheduled workflows and confirm successful processing.
•	Support data-quality controls necessary to maintain reliable project and portfolio reporting.
 
8. Dynamic View & Secure Data Access
•	Configure and maintain Smartsheet Dynamic View solutions.
•	Develop role-based views that provide users access to information appropriate to their responsibilities.
•	Configure field visibility, editing capabilities, filters, and user access.
•	Troubleshoot Dynamic View access and record-visibility issues.
•	Ensure Dynamic View configurations align with overall workspace and data-access requirements.
 
Secondary Responsibility: Application Functional Support & Testing
As a secondary responsibility, the individual may assist with the functional testing and support of a new internally developed application hosted in Microsoft Azure.
This is not a software development position. Hands-on coding or Azure development experience is not required.
Responsibilities may include:
•	Develop a functional understanding of the application and its supporting business processes.
•	Participate in testing new functionality and application enhancements.
•	Perform functional, regression, integration, user acceptance, and post-release testing as appropriate.
•	Develop and execute test scenarios based on defined business requirements.
•	Identify, reproduce, and document application defects.
•	Document expected versus actual behavior, steps to reproduce, relevant screenshots, and error messages.
•	Retest defects and fixes delivered by development teams.
•	Perform post-release validation and smoke testing.
•	Work with business users to understand and reproduce reported application issues.
•	Coordinate with developers and technical teams during troubleshooting and defect resolution.
•	Maintain functional documentation, test scenarios, test cases, and user guidance.
•	Provide feedback regarding usability, functional gaps, edge cases, and opportunities for improvement.
The successful candidate does not need to be a developer or write application code but should be technically comfortable learning a new application, understanding its business processes, testing functionality, identifying and documenting issues, and communicating effectively with developers and technical resources.
Project/Demand Intake → Review & Approval → Project Provisioning → Standard Project Workspace → Project Execution → Program & Portfolio Rollup → Executive Reporting → Project Closure

title: Help Developing an Internal Estimating Model for a small laser cutting company
description:
**Custom Laser Cutting Estimation Tool (DXF, STEP & PDF Input)**

### Job Description

We are a small sheet metal laser cutting shop with no internal IT team, but with managed support. We need a practical, easy-to-use estimation tool so we can quickly generate accurate run-time and pricing estimates from customer files.

**What we need:**  
Upload (or drop in) PDF prints, DXF files, and ideally STEP files. The tool should extract key geometry data—cut length of the flat profile, number of holes/pierces, overall geometry/complexity—and calculate estimated cut time and price based on:

- Material type and thickness  
- Cut length  
- Hole/pierce count  
- Our configurable rates and rules  

**Must-haves:**
- Simple enough for non-technical shop staff to use daily
- Easy for us to update materials, thicknesses, rates, and formulas without a developer
- Suitable for a tiny company (no IT support). We are open to local/desktop, simple web app, or low-maintenance cloud—whatever is most practical and maintainable
- Clean, well-documented code we can understand and update later

**Nice-to-haves:**
- Experience with CAD file parsing (DXF/STEP), geometry analysis, or manufacturing estimation tools
- Familiarity with AI-assisted / “vibe coding” workflows if it produces solid, maintainable results
- Basic nesting or material utilization insight (not required for MVP)

**Deliverables:**
- Working prototype or MVP
- Full source code
- Simple user guide and notes on how to update rates/materials
- Deployment/setup instructions suitable for non-IT users

We are looking for a developer who can deliver something practical and reliable rather than over-engineered. Happy to start with a prototype milestone to confirm approach and fit.

**Skills preferred:** Python (ezdxf, geometry/CAD libraries), simple UI frameworks (Streamlit, Gradio, PyQt, etc.), file parsing, estimation logic.

I can provide sample CAD files, and the spreadsheet I currently use for estimating.

Please include in your proposal: relevant experience with CAD files or estimation tools, your suggested tech approach for a small no-IT shop, and rough timeline/budget for an MVP.

- Experience with CAD file parsing (DXF/STEP), geometry analysis, or manufacturing estimation tools
- Familiarity with AI-assisted / “vibe coding” workflows if it produces solid, maintainable results
- Basic nesting or material utilization insight (not required for MVP)

**Deliverables:**
- Working prototype or MVP
- Full source code
- Simple user guide and notes on how to update rates/materials
- Deployment/setup instructions suitable for non-IT users

We are looking for a developer who can deliver something practical and reliable rather than over-engineered. Happy to start with a prototype milestone to confirm approach and fit.

**Skills preferred:** Python (ezdxf, geometry/CAD libraries), simple UI frameworks (Streamlit, Gradio, PyQt, etc.), file parsing, estimation logic.

I can provide sample CAD files, and the spreadsheet I currently use for estimating.

Please include in your proposal: relevant experience with CAD files or estimation tools, your suggested tech approach for a small no-IT shop, and rough timeline/budget for an MVP.

title: Senior Clay + HubSpot GTM Systems Architect | Enrichment, CRM Governance & Signals
AI-Powered Lead Generation & Sales Automation Web Platform
description:
We're looking for an experienced developer or small development team to build an AI-powered web application that helps businesses discover, qualify, and respond to potential sales opportunities.

The goal is to reduce the time spent manually researching leads, reviewing opportunities, and preparing personalized outreach messages and proposals.

We want to build a practical, user-friendly platform that combines AI, workflow automation, third-party integrations, and a modern web dashboard.

Key Features
====
1. Automated Lead Discovery
- Integrate with external APIs and data sources to identify potential leads and business opportunities.
- Collect and organize relevant company, contact, and opportunity information.
- Allow users to filter opportunities by industry, relevance, budget, and other criteria.

2. AI-Powered Lead Qualification
- Use AI and machine learning to assess and categorize opportunities.
- Match opportunities against configurable business requirements and preferences.
- Provide relevance scores and recommendations to help users prioritize leads.

3. AI-Generated Outreach & Proposals
- Generate personalized outreach messages, introductory emails, and sales proposals using AI.
- Adapt generated content based on company information, opportunity requirements, and user preferences.
- Allow users to review, edit, and approve generated content before using it.

4. Web Dashboard
- Develop a responsive dashboard for managing leads and opportunities.
- Display lead information, qualification results, generated content, and workflow status.
- Support searching, filtering, editing, and tracking opportunities through different stages.

5. API Integrations & Workflow Automation
- Connect the platform with relevant third-party services and databases.
- Automate repetitive steps in the lead research and proposal preparation process.
- Support data synchronization and reliable handling of API responses.

6. User Experience & Administration
- Create a clean, intuitive user interface.
- Include user authentication and basic account management.
- Provide configurable settings for qualification criteria, AI content generation, and workflow preferences.

Technical Requirements
====
We're open to recommendations on the best technical architecture.

Relevant technologies may include Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, AWS, and AI/LLM APIs.

Experience with API integrations, AI-powered applications, workflow automation, and modern web development will be particularly valuable.

We would also welcome suggestions for the UI/UX design and the most practical approach to delivering an initial MVP.

Expected Deliverables
====
- Working MVP of the web application.
- AI-powered lead qualification and personalized content generation.
- Functional lead management dashboard.
- Integration with agreed external APIs.
- Basic testing and documentation.
- Deployment to an agreed hosting environment.

Ideal Candidate
====
We're looking for someone who has experience building real-world AI-enabled web applications, rather than just standalone AI demos.

You should be comfortable working across AI integration, backend development, frontend development, and automation.

Please include examples of relevant applications you've developed, explain your proposed technical approach, and provide an indicative timeline and budget.

We're interested in starting with a manageable MVP and potentially expanding the platform with additional features after the initial release.
